title: Symmetrical Bars
description: This resource pack makes the iron and copper bars's texture symmetrical
body:
Symmetrical Bars

Fix the uneven look of bars in Minecraft with a simple, vanilla-friendly tweak.

Symmetrical Bars redesigns iron bars and all copper variants to have a clean, centered grid pattern. No more offset lines or awkward connections—just neat, balanced bars that look great in builds.

✨ Features:
🔩 Symmetrical Iron Bars
🟧 Symmetrical Copper Bars
🟩 Includes:
Exposed Copper Bars
Weathered Copper Bars
Oxidized Copper Bars
Waxed variants
🎨 Vanilla-style textures (fits seamlessly with the game)
🧩 Compatible with most resource packs
🏗️ Perfect for
Builders who want cleaner designs
Prisons, dungeons, and industrial builds
📦 Details
Resolution: 16x16
No OptiFine required
Lightweight & performance-friendly
